# Shukayu

> Shukayu is a reverse-auction marketplace for buying and selling goods in Ukraine. Buyers post what they want to buy; sellers send price offers; the buyer picks the best deal. Service requests are also supported.

Site: https://shukayu.com.ua
Languages: Ukrainian (default, /uk), English (/en)

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk): Platform overview, how it works, FAQ
- [Browse requests](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/request): Live buyer product requests for sellers
- [Categories](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/categories): Buyer requests by product/service category and city
- [Create request](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/create): Post a free product request as a buyer
- [Blog](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/blog): Tips for buyers and sellers
- [How it works](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/how-it-works): Step-by-step flow from request to deal
- [About](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/about): Mission and platform principles
- [Contact](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/contact): Contact the Shukayu team
- [Support](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/support): Help and common questions
- [Terms](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/terms): Terms of use
- [Privacy](https://shukayu.com.ua/uk/privacy): Privacy policy

English equivalents use the /en prefix (e.g. https://shukayu.com.ua/en/request).

## Product model

1. Buyer creates a request for goods (category, budget, location, urgency). Service requests are also possible.
2. Sellers browse requests and send offers (price, timeline, terms).
3. Buyer compares offers, chats with sellers, and accepts one offer.
4. After the deal, users leave reviews that build profile reputation.
